instruction:
Compare the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B and Raspberry Pi 5 in their listed 4GB variants, BBC micro:bit revisions 1.5 and 2.2x, and BeagleBone Black and BeaglePlay. Use official product/reference HTML, including https://tech.microbit.org/hardware/1-5-revision/, its 2.2x companion and https://www.beagleboard.org/boards/beagleplay with its BeagleBone Black companion. Produce six rows covering principal processor and core clock, main working RAM, explicitly documented onboard flash or eMMC, wired-network interface and onboard wireless. Keep main-processor memory separate from interface-controller or auxiliary-core memory, and removable storage separate from onboard flash. Identify every board whose listed specifications establish each requirement: at least 2GB main RAM plus Gigabit Ethernet and onboard Wi-Fi; at least 4GB onboard eMMC; a microcontroller board with at least 128KB main RAM and an onboard speaker; and exactly 512MB main RAM with 4GB eMMC and a 10/100 Ethernet port. Show the MHz-to-GHz conversions and the main RAM, main flash and CPU-clock growth factors between the two micro:bit revisions. Preserve manufacturer units and report unestablished fields without assuming an add-on or an undocumented absence. Cite each shortlist and give two limits on using memory/clock figures alone to predict practical performance. Do not connect hardware or run examples.

Stopping condition: Stop when six sourced specification rows, four shortlists, clock conversions, three revision growth factors and two performance cautions are complete.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.criterion: Extract hardware specifications for Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 4GB
items.description: Extract the six requested fields (principal processor, core clock, main working RAM, onboard flash/eMMC, wired-network interface, and onboard wireless) for the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 4GB. Full credit if all available fields are accurately reported, preserving manufacturer units and distinguishing main memory from auxiliary/removable memory. If a field is genuinely undocumented on the official page, full credit for explicitly reporting it as unestablished/unavailable. Partial credit for missing or incorrect fields. Support the specification row with the observed official manufacturer source URL(s).

Identify the boards that have at least 2GB main RAM, Gigabit Ethernet, and onboard Wi-Fi based on the gathered specs, and cite the shortlist. Full credit if the correct boards are identified with a citation, or if the identification logically follows from the specs the agent found (accounting for external site changes). Partial credit if a board is missed or incorrectly added. Support the shortlist with the observed official manufacturer source URLs, including when specifications differ at run time; do not assume undocumented absence or add-on capabilities.

Identify the boards that have at least 4GB of onboard eMMC based on the gathered specs, and cite the shortlist. Full credit for correct identification and citation, or logical identification based on found specs. Partial credit for missing a board or incorrectly adding a board. Support the shortlist with the observed official manufacturer source URLs, including when specifications differ at run time; do not assume undocumented absence or add-on capabilities.

Identify every microcontroller board with at least 128KB main RAM and an onboard speaker based on the gathered specs, and cite the shortlist. Full credit for correct identification and citation, or logical identification based on found specs. Partial credit for missing the citation or identifying the wrong board. Support the shortlist with the observed official manufacturer source URLs, including when specifications differ at run time; do not assume undocumented absence or add-on capabilities.

Identify every board with exactly 512MB main RAM, 4GB eMMC, and a 10/100 Ethernet port based on the gathered specs, and cite the shortlist. Full credit for correct identification and citation, or logical identification based on found specs. Partial credit for missing the citation. Support the shortlist with the observed official manufacturer source URLs, including when specifications differ at run time; do not assume undocumented absence or add-on capabilities.

items.criterion: Calculate MHz-to-GHz conversions and micro:bit growth factors
items.description: Provide the MHz-to-GHz conversions for the relevant clocks and state the growth factors for main RAM, main flash, and CPU clock between the BBC micro:bit revisions 1.5 and 2.2x. Full credit if conversions are accurate and all three growth factors are correctly calculated based on the extracted specs. Partial credit if some conversions or growth factors are missing or calculated incorrectly.

items.criterion: Provide limitations on predicting practical performance
items.description: Provide exactly two limits on using memory/clock figures alone to predict practical performance (e.g., architectural differences like IPC, memory bandwidth, cache sizes, or I/O bottlenecks). Full credit for two valid limitations. Partial credit if only one is provided.
